blind.description: A stylized one-handed hammer or warhammer consisting of a carved wooden handle with a metal reinforcing band and a heavy steel head. The head features a faceted, beveled striking face on one side and a thick curved claw or spike on the opposite side. The model surfaces are solid, smooth, and clean, with hand-painted stylized textures indicating wood grain and metallic edge wear.
blind.from_above: A horizontal bar-like shape showing the top edge of the wooden handle on the left leading into the metallic hammer head on the right, casting a clear hammer-shaped shadow northward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet long overall, reaching around 1 foot high at its tilted angle, roughly a third the height of the figure's base to hip.
